title: Thacker Pass Water and Reclamation Permit Notices of Decision — Phase 65 Nevada lithium project delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Nevada lithium project delivery reporting pack. NDEP's combined decision record documents issuance of the Thacker Pass water-pollution-control and mine-reclamation permits after the state review process.
key_findings: The state issued decisions for both mining permits on February 25, 2022.
The decision record fixes the authorization milestone separately from later permit compliance.
Permit issuance does not establish that construction, operation, or reclamation obligations were performed.
why_it_matters: Which records separate land and environmental authorization, financing, construction, commissioning, compliance, qualification, customer acceptance, and repeat output? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. It establishes the formal state decision date without collapsing it into delivery.
ftfn_relevance: Adds the decision layer behind the existing permit hub.
Supports a complete permit provenance trail.
Keeps approval separate from implementation and output.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
The decisions do not prove construction or operation.
They do not establish later compliance, water impacts, reclamation performance, or production.
